π ≈ 3.14159265. It is a “transcendental,” irrational number, and is commonly approximated by the fraction 22/7. Although it has an infinite number of digits and no repeating patterns, many people engage in the practice of memorizing the digits in the constant using mnemonic devices, such as songs, encoded texts, and even haikus. Some challengers even deign to earn a spot in the Guinness World Records for most digits memorized.
